name: Grow a Fish Pond 🐠🐟
desc:
🐙🐠FISCH grow the biggest FISH 🐋🐟
🐯 Get PETS to roam your pond 🐯

New Update - more ponds, more fish, more everything
🦑Flex HUGE & rare fish with mythical mutations!

[How To Grow Fish]
- Equip the baby fish you want to grow
- Go near/in your pond & click to drop
- Wait to see the fish grow!
- BONUS: Use food to grow the fish in special ways!
- After its fully grown, pick it up & sell it at the store!
